address: Avenida de los Comuneros, Morales de Toro, 49810, Spain
bio: Behind the unpretentious façade of this restaurant (Chivo is the nickname for the family that runs it), you’ll find a simple bar and two dining rooms, one for the set menu, the other for à la carte dining (the latter also features a private space with a rustic yet elegant feel). The verbally presented menu includes homemade stews and a good daily selection of fish, most of which are cooked on the grill....
